songs.lyrics:
[intro]
One cold step outside, and everything had changed

[verse 1: Female Vocal]
The street looked different than it had last night
The first cold morning turned the whole block red
A single maple started off the change
And every step I took, more color spread
I stood there in my coat and just looked on
The season moved while I stood there, unsure
A neighbor's porch had turned to rust and gold

[verse 2: Male Vocal]
A gold came next, then orange down the walk
The air turned sharp, the kind that wakes you fast
I'd walked this street a hundred plain grey mornings
And none of them looked anything like this last
The whole world seemed to change its mind at once
And I stood there and let it have its way
I hadn't known a season had this much to give

[chorus: Male and Female Duet]
One cold step and the whole street turned
Everything I thought I knew, relearned
One small leaf sparked the color spreading wide
Color Comes to Stay

[chorus: Male and Female Duet]
Red, then gold, then orange too
A street I thought I always knew
A hundred trees all catching up at once
Color Comes to Stay

[final chorus: Male and Female Duet Harmony]
Color Comes to Stay
Red and gold and orange, bright and true
The whole street changed, and I did too
Color Comes to Stay
